scientific_role: same-gallery image-label-normal-only direct anomaly candidate ranking with classification held bit-exact to accepted Geometry-v3
hypothesis: A fixed nominal descriptor bank can expose lesion-like candidates through nearest-normal cosine distance without learning a positive-bag residual or inheriting the candidate-count classification shortcut.

coordination.non_duplicate_scope: N1 uses only the accepted old same-gallery cache and neither generates nor merges rich-gallery candidates nor imports collaborator logits, checkpoints, fusion or source-balanced objective code.

normal_bank.weighting: equal total mass per image, then per family within image, then per candidate and view within family

candidate_ranking.original_score: one minus maximum cosine similarity to the 32 normalized nominal prototypes
candidate_ranking.flipped_score: one minus maximum cosine similarity to the same 32 normalized nominal prototypes
candidate_ranking.combined_score: float32 mean of aligned original and flip normal distances
candidate_ranking.winner: first argmax in immutable ascending candidate-index order
candidate_ranking.prediction_map: selected immutable bit-packed candidate mask multiplied by accepted baseline bag probability

execution.prototype_fit_device: CPU inside the T4x2 Kaggle job

must_recompute: the complete equal image-family-candidate-view weight vector from 1493 image-label-normal cache records
the deterministic K32 seed42 spherical prototype bank and cluster assignments
all original and flip nearest-prototype distances and their float32 mean for 371 validation bags
all physical prediction maps from bit-packed masks and frozen baseline probabilities
the exact validation candidate-count versus preserved probability Spearman
gt_blind_independent_audit_before_evalua.failure_action: reject N1 before validation GT; record the error boundary before any correction or rerun

prediction_freeze.candidate_scores: all candidates in immutable gallery order
must_bind: scientific source commit and this protocol SHA-256
split, selector-cache freeze, manifest and physical cache records
accepted baseline freeze, manifest, logits and probabilities
normal bank, bank audit, all candidate scores and view evidence
371 prediction maps, manifests, T4x2 runtime and safety fields

literature_basis.technique: PatchCore nominal feature memory and nearest-normal feature distance
literature_basis.transfer_boundary: Only the nominal-memory and nearest-feature-distance principle is transferred; no industrial benchmark claim, ImageNet encoder, coreset ratio or pixel threshold is transferred.

prohibited: validation segmentation GT before prediction freeze and independent physical audit
validation subgroup, Dice, candidate Dice or oracle rank during bank fit or candidate scoring
positive-bag training, inferred positive candidate targets, BCE, residual or MIL optimizer
reuse of R1/T1 learned outputs or collaborator G1/G2 logits, checkpoints, fusion or objective
proposal generation, rich-gallery merge or candidate-gallery change
K, seed, blend, threshold, score, prototype or evaluator sweep
downstream consumer training before every adoption gate passes
